title: Unused Script
description:
Unused-code rule — scripts never called by another script and never started by a trigger. Review: manual / custom-menu starts can appear here.

Based on the PMD rule UnusedPrivateMethod — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_bestpractices.html#unusedprivatemethod
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Dead scripts inflate the solution, slow analysis and hide intent.
rule.remediation: Confirm the script is not started manually / from a custom menu / externally, then delete it.
